---
title: Copy a Frozen Resource
---

# Copy a Frozen Resource

Active or archived resources cannot be patched. Use copy-on-write to create a
new mutable resource derived from the frozen source.

## Copy through a scoped `RecapClient`

```python
copied = namespace.copy_resource(
    source_resource_id=source.id,
    changes={
        "name": "Sample Plate Copy",
        "changes": {
            "properties": {
                "content": {"catalog_id": "new-catalog-id"}
            }
        },
    },
)
```

The scoped `RecapClient` supplies destination namespace from its bound path and
shares connection state with its source client.
The remote REST request is:

```http
POST /api/v1/resources/{source_resource_id}/copies
```

```json
{
  "destination_namespace": "beamline/amx",
  "name": "Sample Plate Copy",
  "changes": {
    "properties": {
      "content": {"catalog_id": "new-catalog-id"}
    }
  }
}
```

## Copy semantics

RECAP validates source identity and destination namespace, requires source read
and destination write permission, then deep-copies the complete resource graph.
The copy receives fresh resource, property, and value identities. The root
stores `copied_from_id` so lineage remains queryable.

Source activation and destination insertion commit together. If validation or
copy fails, neither source lifecycle nor destination graph is partially changed.
